strings.help.command_body:
Yomihime Quota Link
Usage:
  /yql                 Query all accounts
  /yql help            Show help
  /yql status          Show local settings status
  /yql all             Query all accounts
  /yql <name>          Query an account or provider
  /yql account <name>  Query an account
  /yql provider <name> Query a provider

strings.help.tool_note: In AI chats with function tools enabled, ask the model to call yql_query_balance in natural language.

strings.web.alert.query_only: This preset supports manual quota queries.
strings.web.alert.recovery_hint: Leave blank to set automatically. Must be above the trigger threshold.
strings.web.alert.repeat_hint: Use 0 to disable repeats. Maximum: 4320 minutes.
strings.web.alert.smart_hint_help: Uses the destination session’s model and persona.
strings.web.alert.targets_hint: Enter one UMO per line. For OneBot groups, append @ followed by a QQ number. For official QQ, use an OpenID and append scene=qq_group for group chats or scene=qq_c2c for private chats. Leave out channels and channel direct messages.
strings.web.alert.threshold_hint: An alert triggers when the balance is at or below this value.
strings.web.alert.title: Quota alerts
strings.web.credential.clear_body: This removes the credential or reference for “{account}”. Account settings are kept. Configure the credential again before querying.
strings.web.credential.environment_hint: Enter only the variable name, such as QUOTA_API_KEY. The runtime supplies its value.
strings.web.credential.finish_settings: Save or discard settings changes before editing credentials.
strings.web.credential.new_value_hint: Leaving this blank keeps the existing credential. The input is cleared immediately after submission.
strings.web.credential.save_account: Save the new account before adding credentials.
strings.web.credential.saved_hint: Credentials are saved and will be verified when querying the balance.
strings.web.credential.title: Query credentials
strings.web.detail.legacy_target_unknown: A legacy send record could not be matched to the destination, so its outcome is unknown. Official QQ alerts resume after the balance recovers and then falls to or below the threshold again.
strings.web.detail.mention_invalid: Invalid QQ mention format. Check the group session and @QQ number.
strings.web.detail.mention_unsupported: The destination does not support QQ mentions. Remove the @ suffix or use a supported QQ group.
strings.web.detail.message_components_unavailabl: Could not construct the message components. Check the host components and logs.
strings.web.detail.platform_not_found: Destination platform instance was not found. Check the platform instance ID in the UMO.
strings.web.detail.platform_unavailable: The destination platform instance is unavailable. Check the connection and host logs.
strings.web.detail.platform_unsupported: The destination platform does not support this outbound delivery method. Use a supported destination.
strings.web.detail.session_check_failed: Could not verify the destination session. Check AstrBot session settings and logs.
strings.web.detail.session_disabled: The destination session is disabled. Enable it in AstrBot.
strings.web.detail.target_invalid: Invalid alert destination format. Check the UMO in Global settings.
strings.web.detail.target_scene_required: The official QQ destination is missing its chat type. Specify it in Global settings or run /yql alert targets addhere in the destination chat.
strings.web.detail.transport_unavailable: The host outbound delivery API is unavailable. Check the AstrBot version and logs.
strings.web.detail.unknown: No specific reason is available. Check global alert destinations, platform connections, and host alert logs.
strings.web.hint.advanced_options: Configure authentication, method, and response mapping for generic services. Grsai account credits use a fixed protocol and ignore old mappings.
strings.web.hint.auth_mode: Follow the balance API documentation. Grsai account credits ignore this field and always put the token in the JSON body.
strings.web.hint.auth_name: Used only with request header or query parameter authentication.
strings.web.hint.balance_scope: Account credits are supported. API key credit queries are currently unavailable.
strings.web.hint.base_url: HTTPS base URL without the API path. https://api.example.invalid is an example and cannot be reached.
strings.web.hint.gateway_origin: Enter the site’s HTTPS origin. The query credential is sent only to that site.
strings.web.hint.json_body: For generic services only. Templates and credentials are unsupported. Leave blank for Grsai account credits and clear any old body when switching an entry.
strings.web.hint.legacy_base_url: HTTPS base URL, optionally combined with an API path.
strings.web.hint.legacy_json_body: Use only for a documented read-only POST. Templates and credentials are unsupported.
strings.web.hint.legacy_method: Use GET or a POST confirmed to have no side effects.
strings.web.hint.meinianda_cache: The site recommends querying once per minute. The default cache is 60 seconds.
strings.web.hint.method: Follow the documentation for generic services. Grsai account credits always use POST. Clear the previous GET method when switching an existing entry.
strings.web.hint.path: Follow the documentation for generic services. For Grsai account credits, leave blank or enter /client/openapi/getCredits. Clear the previous path when switching an existing entry. /account/balance is an example only.
strings.web.hint.private_allowlist: Enter the full platform:userID, for example aiocqhttp:123456. Administrators can query without being listed. The administrator-only switch above also applies to /yql balance queries.
strings.web.hint.region: Both regions use built-in official endpoints. No server address is needed.
strings.web.hint.service_profile: Balance queries use provider-specific endpoints. Use the Grsai template for new Grsai accounts. Existing entries here can switch to the account credit preset.
strings.web.hint.status_values: Map provider status values to available/unavailable/partial/unknown.
strings.web.hint.unit: Allowed: CNY/USD/JPY/credit/credits/tokens/requests/custom. Required when unit_path is set.
strings.web.hint.unit_path: Optional JSON Pointer. The runtime value must match the fixed unit.
strings.web.hint.url: Full HTTPS URL without a query, credentials, or fragment.
strings.web.migration.cleanup_hint: Legacy host configuration is removed only after migration succeeds. If the source changes, preview again before migrating.
strings.web.migration.cleanup_pending: Migration was saved, but the host’s legacy fields still need cleanup. Preview again before retrying.
strings.web.migration.confirm_body: Migrate the {count} accounts in the preview. Plaintext credentials will be encrypted before storage, and legacy plugin fields will be cleaned up. Credentials stay hidden and are never sent to other services.
strings.web.migration.conflict: Legacy configuration differs from the current encrypted store. Verify the source manually. The existing store and newly detected configuration are kept intact.
strings.web.migration.lock_warning: Legacy configuration is waiting for migration. Settings and credential changes are temporarily locked.
strings.web.migration.overview: Move settings, credentials, and environment variable references from the legacy plugin configuration to managed storage. Credentials are stored encrypted and hidden on this page.
strings.web.migration.pending: Legacy configuration detected. Finish migration before saving new settings.
strings.web.migration.title: Legacy configuration migration
strings.web.navigation.leave_body: Unsaved settings and credential input will be cleared. Requests already sent cannot be withdrawn. Reload to verify an uncertain outcome before trying again.
strings.web.navigation.reload_body: This clears unsaved settings and credential input.
strings.web.notice.alert_read_failed: Could not verify the alert runtime status. Try again later.
strings.web.notice.authorization_lost: Admin authorization expired. Drafts were cleared. Reopen the page from AstrBot plugin management.
strings.web.notice.authorization_reopen: Admin authorization expired. Reopen this page.
strings.web.notice.config_changed: The configuration changed. Reload to see the current settings.
strings.web.notice.connecting: Connecting to the host admin session…
strings.web.notice.invalid_context: Invalid host admin context. Open this page from AstrBot plugin management.
strings.web.notice.invalid_environment: Enter a valid environment variable name without its value.
strings.web.notice.left_during_write: You left the previous settings. A request already sent cannot be withdrawn. Reload to verify its outcome.
strings.web.notice.legacy_cleanup_incomplete: Configuration migrated, but legacy fields remain. Preview again under Configuration maintenance to finish cleanup.
strings.web.notice.legacy_cleanup_retry: Migration was saved. You can retry cleanup of the original legacy fields.
strings.web.notice.legacy_conflict: Legacy configuration differs from the current store. Both are kept intact.
strings.web.notice.legacy_preview_ready: Migration preview is ready. Review the scope below before proceeding.
strings.web.notice.missing_credential: Enter a new credential. Leaving it blank keeps the existing one.
strings.web.notice.open_in_host: Open this page from AstrBot plugin management.
strings.web.notice.read_failed: Could not verify the configuration state. Reload or reopen from the host.
strings.web.notice.revision_conflict: Another page changed the configuration. Reload and review it before submitting again. No automatic retry will occur.
strings.web.notice.saved: Saved and verified the current state.
strings.web.notice.saving: Submitting. Wait for the result before trying again…
strings.web.notice.session_unavailable: The host admin session is unavailable. Reopen this page.
strings.web.notice.unit_candidate_changed: The unit option changed or expired. Query again before confirming.
strings.web.notice.unit_candidates: New unit options are available. Review them and confirm one.
strings.web.notice.unit_confirm_uncertain: Confirmation outcome is unknown. Refresh the unit status before taking further action.
strings.web.notice.unit_current: Loaded the latest unit status. The confirmed unit remains valid.
strings.web.notice.unit_no_candidates: No unit options are available. Check the credentials, endpoint, and query status before trying again.
strings.web.notice.unit_querying: Querying the balance for the latest unit…
strings.web.notice.unit_read_failed: Could not read the unit. Refresh and try again.
strings.web.notice.unit_unverified_candidates: Could not verify any new unit options. Check the credentials, endpoint, and query status before trying again.
strings.web.notice.validation_failed: Submission failed validation. Check fields and credential types. Sensitive input was cleared.
strings.web.notice.write_uncertain: Submission outcome is unconfirmed. Sensitive input was cleared. Reload to verify the state before resubmitting.
strings.web.provider.alibaba_help: Alibaba Cloud BSS: cash balance, available quota, and credit limit.
strings.web.provider.compatible_help: Configure the provider’s read-only balance endpoint using its documentation.
strings.web.provider.deepseek_help: DeepSeek official balance. The query endpoint and response parsing are built in.
strings.web.provider.glm_plan_help: Use a GLM Coding Plan key for the selected region to query usage percentages for each reported window.
strings.web.provider.grsai_help: Grsai account credits use the request token and the fixed POST /client/openapi/getCredits endpoint. The model API key is unused.
strings.web.provider.meinianda_help: Queries the Meinianda account’s site credits. A cache of at least 60 seconds is recommended.
strings.web.provider.minimax_plan_help: Use a Token Plan key for the selected region to query each model group’s interval and weekly quotas.
strings.web.provider.moonshot_help: Show the selected Moonshot region’s available, cash, and promotional balances separately.
strings.web.provider.new_api_help: Query the model token’s quota and any account quota it may read. Values stay in the site’s original quota points.
strings.web.provider.novita_help: Query Novita AI’s available balance, cash balance, credit limit, and outstanding invoices.
strings.web.provider.openrouter_help: Use a management key to read purchased and spent OpenRouter credits and calculate the remaining credits.
strings.web.provider.pollinations_help: Use a key with account:usage permission to query the account’s Pollen. Held credits appear separately.
strings.web.provider.stepfun_help: Query the selected StepFun region. Lifetime deposits and promotional credits appear separately.
strings.web.provider.sub2api_help: Use a Sub2API model key to query the site wallet or an explicitly reported key quota.
strings.web.provider.venice_help: Use an admin API key for Venice. USD, DIEM, and other credit balances appear separately.
strings.web.provider.vercel_gateway_help: Use an AI Gateway key to query the team’s USD balance and lifetime spend.
strings.web.provider.xai_help: Use the team’s management key to query its posted xAI prepaid balance.
strings.web.runtime.no_account_record: This account has no runtime history yet.
strings.web.runtime.running: Checks are running for accounts with alerts enabled and all required settings in place.
strings.web.runtime.storage_unavailable: Alert state storage is unavailable. Alerts are inactive.
strings.web.runtime.title: Runtime status
strings.web.runtime.unknown_status: Status updated. Use the alert command for details.
strings.web.settings.account_alerts: Alerts can be enabled per account.
strings.web.settings.admin_access: Only AstrBot administrators can open and configure this page.
strings.web.settings.admin_allowlist: Administrators do not need to be on the private chat allowlist.
strings.web.settings.command_access: The administrator-only setting applies to /yql balance queries. Alert commands have separate access rules.
strings.web.settings.group_access: Group queries require the group query switch and must meet the user allowlist rules.
strings.web.settings.language_hint: Applies after saving. Automatic mode uses the language provided by AstrBot. When no supported language is available, such as for scheduled alerts, Quota Link uses Simplified Chinese.
strings.web.settings.private_format: Use the full platform:userID in the private chat allowlist.
strings.web.settings.separate_credentials: Settings and credentials are saved separately
strings.web.shell.open_from_host: Sign in to AstrBot, then open Quota Query from the plugin details page.
strings.web.status.accepted: Send request accepted. Delivery is unconfirmed.
strings.web.status.auth_paused: Credentials were rejected. Checks are paused.
strings.web.status.blocked: Alert delivery is paused. Check the reason below.
strings.web.status.error: Check failed. The previous alert state is retained.
strings.web.status.incomplete: Configuration is incomplete. Monitoring has not started.
strings.web.status.low: Balance is at or below the threshold. The alert remains active.
strings.web.status.paused: Authentication or permission check failed. Correct the settings or retry manually to resume checks.
strings.web.status.recovering: Balance has risen and remains below the recovery threshold
strings.web.status.stale: The result expired or its metric or unit differs. It will be skipped for alert evaluation.
strings.web.status.storage_unavailable: Alert state storage is unavailable. Alerts are inactive.
strings.web.status.submitted: Submitted to the platform. Final delivery is unconfirmed.
strings.web.status.unit_changed: Monitored metric or unit changed. Confirm the new unit.
strings.web.status.unknown: Delivery outcome is unknown. Verify before retrying.
strings.web.status.waiting_budget: Waiting at least five minutes between sends to the same destination. Delivery will be retried after a later valid check.
strings.web.storage.key_handling: The runtime manages the master key. It cannot be entered, exported, or restored on this page.
strings.web.storage.title: Storage security
strings.web.storage.troubleshooting: For storage failures, check the host logs for security error codes. Keep keys out of public logs and screenshots.
strings.web.storage.unavailable_warning: Encrypted storage is unavailable. Check the runtime before saving new credentials. Plaintext storage is disabled.
strings.web.unit.ambiguous: Multiple units were found. Select one.
strings.web.unit.candidates_stale: The query candidates expired. Query again. Confirmed unit records are kept.
strings.web.unit.changed: The query unit changed. Confirm it again.
strings.web.unit.choices_expired: The candidates expired. Query again before choosing a unit.
strings.web.unit.confirm_no_threshold: Switch to {unit}? No threshold is set yet.
strings.web.unit.confirm_observed: Confirm the unit returned by the query.
strings.web.unit.confirm_threshold: Switch to {unit} and compare against the threshold {threshold}?
strings.web.unit.detect_on_account_save: Save the account to detect the unit.
strings.web.unit.detect_on_query: The unit is detected after a balance query.
strings.web.unit.detect_on_save: Save settings to redetect the unit.
strings.web.unit.finish_credential_before_query: Finish or cancel credential entry before querying again.
strings.web.unit.metric_changed: Monitored metric changed from {previous} to {current}. Confirm the unit and thresholds again.
strings.web.unit.metric_edited: The monitored metric changed to “{metric}”. Save, query again, and confirm the unit.
strings.web.unit.metric_or_unit_changed: The monitored metric or unit changed. Confirm again.
strings.web.unit.no_choices: No candidates are available. Query again before choosing a unit.
strings.web.unit.query_changed: Query settings changed. Confirm the unit and thresholds again.
strings.web.unit.query_edited: Query settings changed. Save them to redetect the unit.
strings.web.unit.query_hint: Queries this account’s balance endpoint for new candidates without sending an alert.
strings.web.unit.save_before_query: Save settings to query the unit again.
strings.web.unit.title: Alert unit
strings.web.unit.verified_expired: Unit verified. Query candidates expired, but the confirmed unit remains valid.
strings.web.validation.account_bounds: The account timeout is capped at 120 seconds and the cache at 86400 seconds.
strings.web.validation.account_id: Account IDs must be present and unique.
strings.web.validation.account_positive: Account timeout and cache values must be positive.
strings.web.validation.alert_prerequisites: Before enabling alerts, enable the account, enter a threshold, and add at least one global alert destination.
strings.web.validation.decimal_length: Use up to 30 integer digits and 18 decimal places, without exponent notation.
strings.web.validation.duplicate_umo: Duplicate UMO. Combine the entries into one line.
strings.web.validation.finite_decimal: Enter a finite decimal string without an exponent.
strings.web.validation.global_bounds: Check the limits shown for global settings.
strings.web.validation.group_mentions: Only numeric QQ group sessions support @QQ numbers. Remove the @ suffix from private and other sessions.
strings.web.validation.id_limit: Up to {limit} QQ numbers are allowed.
strings.web.validation.interval_input: Enter a whole number from 1 to 4320. The value is never adjusted automatically.
strings.web.validation.interval_range: Check interval must be a whole number of minutes from 1 to 4320.
strings.web.validation.json_object: Enter a valid JSON object without credentials.
strings.web.validation.llm_ids: Model and persona IDs must be text up to 128 characters long.
strings.web.validation.mentions_suffix: After the UMO, enter space-separated @QQ numbers, or specify scene=qq_group or scene=qq_c2c for official QQ.
strings.web.validation.metric: Choose a metric supported by this provider.
strings.web.validation.private_allowlist: Use platform:userID for the private chat allowlist.
strings.web.validation.qq_id: Use a positive QQ number of 1 to 20 ASCII digits. @all, nicknames, and CQ codes are unsupported.
strings.web.validation.recovery_order: Recovery threshold must be higher than the trigger threshold.
strings.web.validation.repeat_input: Enter a whole number of minutes from 0 to 4320.
strings.web.validation.repeat_range: Repeat interval must be a whole number of minutes from 0 to 4320. Use 0 to disable repeats.
strings.web.validation.target_fields: Each destination needs a UMO and a mention list.
strings.web.validation.target_limit: Up to 20 alert destinations are allowed.
strings.web.validation.umo_invisible: UMO cannot contain control or invisible characters.
strings.web.validation.umo_type: Message type must be FriendMessage, GroupMessage, or OtherMessage.
strings.web.validation.unit: Enter a unit of up to 32 characters.

metadata.short_desc: Monitor AI API balances and usage
metadata.desc: Query AI API balances, usage, and quotas. Manage accounts and configure quota alerts in one place.

enable_admin_page.hint: Manage accounts, credentials, query permissions, and timeouts from the plugin page. Legacy settings are kept until you confirm migration.
